system.description: You share an affinity with another Cainite — most likely a fellow Toreador, though possibly of another clan — that arose naturally rather than through a Blood Oath or other artifice. You would lay down your unlife for each other and feel empty apart; such bonds may be between any combination of sexes, and there's no telling in advance who your "twin" will be. At three dots, you can occasionally sense the other's strong emotions (fear, joy, pain) while in the vicinity; at five dots, you often sense those emotions even at a distance, and can feel the other's physical pain or peril.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans (Toreador)
